answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 61 epochs of grading, and every ember settlement recomputes the pulse schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 61 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
